themes.scene: a sunny farm: a big plain sky-blue sky with two flat white rounded clouds and a simple yellow sun, wide soft green rolling hills as flat bands of color, a few lollipop trees, a small simple red barn with a short fence at the far left edge
a cozy kitchen: a pale yellow wall with a round window showing blue sky, a few simple pastel cabinets and a hanging lamp at the top, a long light wooden table across the bottom third

a sunny zoo: plain sky-blue sky with two flat white rounded clouds, a simple yellow sun, a few round green bushes and one tall palm-like tree at the edges, a low simple wooden fence along the far horizon, wide flat sandy-green ground

a cozy kids' playroom: a soft mint wall with a round window showing blue sky, a simple low shelf and an open wooden toy box at the far right edge, a large plain warm-cream rug covering the bottom part of the floor

a bright cheerful art corner: a soft cream wall, a simple wooden easel and a few paint pots at the far left edge, a small rainbow painted on the wall at the top right, a plain light wooden floor across the bottom

words.art: a chubby orange kitten sitting, waving one paw, tail curled up beside it, head almost as big as its body
words.tip: 看到小猫（绘本、楼下、视频都行）就指着问：Where is the cat? 孩子指对了说：Yes! A cat! 再一起学：Meow!

words.art: a round brown-and-cream puppy with floppy ears, sitting, small pink tongue out happily

en.say: Woof woof! The dog says woof.

words.tip: 遛弯遇到小狗时，蹲下来轻声说：Look, a dog! Woof woof! 回家可以玩“学小狗”：你说 dog，孩子学 Woof。

words.art: a chubby white cow with a few round black patches, pink muzzle, two tiny horns, standing
words.tip: 喝牛奶时顺口说：Milk comes from the cow. Moo! 让孩子也 Moo 一声。

words.art: a round pink pig seen from the front, small round snout in the middle of its face, tiny ears, curly tail, standing

en.say: Oink oink! The pig says oink.

words.tip: 洗澡时捏捏小鼻子说：Oink oink! You're a little pig! 孩子会觉得很好玩。

words.art: a round yellow duckling with an orange beak and orange feet, little wings slightly raised

en.say: Quack quack! The duck says quack.

words.tip: 洗澡放小黄鸭：Where is the duck? 孩子拿起来，你说：Quack quack! Yes, a duck!

words.art: a round white hen with a red comb, small yellow beak and short orange legs, standing

en.say: Cluck cluck! The chicken says cluck.

words.tip: 早餐吃鸡蛋时说：The chicken says cluck cluck. 可以张开手臂学小鸡扇翅膀。

words.art: a round sheep with a puffy cloud-shaped white wool body, cream face and little dark legs, standing
words.tip: 摸毛绒玩具或毛衣时说：So soft, like a sheep. Baa!

words.art: a chubby brown pony with a cream mane, standing on four short legs, seen from the front
words.tip: 让孩子骑在你腿上颠一颠：Ride the horse! Neigh! 孩子通常会要求“再来一次”，正好多说几遍。

words.art: a round white bunny with long pink-lined ears, sitting and holding a tiny carrot

en.say: Hop hop! The rabbit can hop.

words.tip: 和孩子一起跳一跳：Hop hop, like a rabbit! 说一次 hop 就跳一下。

words.art: a small round gray mouse with big round pink ears and a thin curly tail, sitting

en.say: Squeak squeak! The mouse says squeak.

words.tip: 玩捉迷藏时小声说：Shh, quiet like a mouse. Squeak!

words.art: a round red apple with a short brown stem and one green leaf, no face
words.tip: 吃苹果前举起来问：What's this? 停两秒，等孩子说或你说：An apple! 咬一口：Crunch!

words.art: a single curved yellow banana, half peeled, no face

en.say: A yellow banana. Peel, peel, yum!

words.tip: 剥香蕉时一边剥一边说：Peel, peel, peel. A banana! 让孩子帮忙剥最后一下。

words.art: a round orange fruit with a tiny green leaf on top, next to one orange slice, no face
words.tip: 切橙子时说：An orange. It's orange! 指指颜色，孩子会发现同一个词两种意思。

words.art: a bunch of round purple grapes with a small green stem and leaf, no face
words.tip: 吃葡萄时一颗一颗数：One grape, two grapes... 数到三就很好。

words.art: a rounded glass of white milk with a little milk splash on top, no face
words.tip: 递牛奶时问：Do you want milk? 等孩子点头或说 yes，再递给他：Here's your milk.

words.art: a rounded clear glass of light blue water with two bubbles and a water drop beside it, no face
words.tip: 孩子要喝水时，先说 water 再给：Water? Here you are. 慢慢地孩子会自己说 water。

words.art: a puffy loaf of golden-brown bread with one slice beside it, no face
words.tip: 早餐时问：Bread or egg? 让孩子指一指选，你把他选的词再说一遍。

words.art: one plain white egg (a smooth blank oval with no features, no eyes, no cheeks, no mouth) standing next to a sunny-side-up fried egg (white and yellow only, no face)
words.tip: 煮鸡蛋时让孩子摸一摸：An egg. Crack! 剥壳时再说一次 egg。

words.art: a round two-layer birthday cake with pink frosting, a cherry on top and one candle, no face
words.tip: 过生日或吃小蛋糕时一起唱：Happy birthday to you! 然后说：Yummy cake!

words.art: a big round golden cookie with chocolate chips, one small bite taken out, no face
words.tip: 给饼干前举在面前：Cookie? 孩子说或点头后：Here's a cookie! 吃完问：More cookie?

words.art: a chubby yellow lion cub sitting, round fluffy orange mane like a sun around its face, tiny tail with a tuft
words.tip: 玩“小狮子”：双手当爪子说 Roar! 让孩子也 Roar，再轻声说 A little lion!

words.art: a round orange tiger cub sitting, three short dark brown stripes on its forehead only, white muzzle, little round ears
words.tip: 看绘本时比较狮子和老虎：Lion or tiger? 让孩子指一指。

words.art: a chubby light grey baby elephant standing, big round ears, short trunk curled up happily

en.say: Toot! The elephant has a long nose.

words.tip: 把手臂放在鼻子前当象鼻甩一甩：I'm an elephant! Toot!

words.art: a round brown monkey sitting, cream face and ears, long curly tail, one hand raised waving

en.say: Ooh ooh, ah ah! The monkey says hi.

words.tip: 吃香蕉时说：Monkeys love bananas! Ooh ooh, ah ah!

words.art: a chubby brown bear cub sitting, round ears, light tan muzzle and round tummy patch
words.tip: 睡前给孩子一个大熊抱：Big bear hug!

words.art: a chubby white panda cub sitting, black round ears, black oval eye patches, black arms and legs, holding one short green bamboo stick

en.say: Munch munch. The panda eats bamboo.

words.tip: 看到黑白相间的东西就问：Like a panda? Black and white!

words.art: a cute yellow baby giraffe standing, long neck, a few big round soft brown spots, two tiny horn knobs

en.say: So tall! The giraffe is tall.

words.tip: 把孩子举高高：So tall! Like a giraffe!

words.art: a chubby white baby zebra standing, only four thick simple black stripes on its body, short black mane
words.tip: 过斑马线时说：Look! Zebra stripes!

words.art: a friendly round-faced green snake coiled in a soft S shape, head raised, small curved smile
words.tip: 用手臂扭来扭去：Wiggle like a snake! Hiss!

words.art: a round green frog sitting, big round eyes on top of its head, wide smile, light green tummy
words.tip: 蹲下来一起跳：Jump like a frog! Ribbit!

words.art: a round bouncy ball in two halves, coral red and sunny yellow, no face
words.tip: 滚球给孩子：Catch the ball! 孩子滚回来再说 Thank you!

words.art: a small round toy car seen from the side, sky blue body, two round windows, two black wheels, no face

en.say: Beep beep! The car goes vroom.

words.tip: 路上看到车：Look, a car! Beep beep!

words.art: a short chunky toy train engine seen from the side, red body, yellow roof, round chimney with one small white puff cloud, black wheels, no face

en.say: Choo choo! The train goes choo choo.

words.tip: 排队搭着肩开小火车：Choo choo! All aboard!

words.art: a small round toy sailboat, coral red hull, one white triangle sail, no water, no face

en.say: Splash! The boat goes on the water.

words.tip: 洗澡时放个小玩具漂：A boat! Splash!

words.art: a chubby toy airplane seen from the side, white body, sky blue wings and tail, round windows, no face

en.say: Zoom! The plane flies up high.

words.tip: 抱起孩子“飞”一圈：Zoom! I'm a plane!

words.art: a simple soft rag doll standing, round face with bean eyes and pink cheeks, short brown yarn hair, pink dress
words.tip: 玩过家家：Give the doll some milk.

words.art: a soft cuddly honey-colored teddy bear sitting, round ears, cream muzzle, small red bow at the neck
words.tip: 睡前：Night night, teddy! 让孩子抱着说。

words.art: three chunky toy building blocks stacked into a small tower, red, yellow and blue cubes, no letters, no face

en.say: Up, up, up! Build with blocks.

words.tip: 搭积木一边数：Up, up, up! 倒了就说 Uh-oh!

words.art: a chunky children's picture book lying open, cover green, plain pages with a simple drawn sun shape, no letters, no face
words.tip: 读绘本前说：Let's read a book! 翻页时说 Turn the page.

words.art: one round pink balloon with a small knot and a short curly string, no face
words.tip: 吹气球让孩子拍：Up, up, balloon!

words.art: one big round soft blob of coral red paint with a few small round drops around it, flat coral red color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 看到红色的东西就指着说：Red! 比如苹果、草莓、红灯。

words.art: one big round soft blob of sky blue paint with a few small round drops around it, flat sky blue color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 看天空时说：Look, the sky is blue! 问孩子：What's blue?

words.art: one big round soft blob of sunny yellow paint with a few small round drops around it, flat sunny yellow color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 剥香蕉时说：Yellow! A yellow banana.

words.art: one big round soft blob of grass green paint with a few small round drops around it, flat grass green color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 在草地上拍拍草说：Green grass! Green!

words.art: one big round soft blob of grape purple paint with a few small round drops around it, flat grape purple color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 吃葡萄时说：Purple grapes! Purple!

words.art: one big round soft blob of soft pink paint with a few small round drops around it, flat soft pink color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 找家里粉色的东西：Find something pink!

words.art: one big round soft blob of black paint with a few small round drops around it, flat black color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 关灯时说：Black! It's dark. 开灯说：Light!

words.art: one big round soft blob of white paint with a few small round drops around it, flat white color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 倒牛奶时说：White milk! White.

words.art: one big round soft blob of chocolate brown paint with a few small round drops around it, flat chocolate brown color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 看到泰迪熊、木头桌子说：Brown!

words.art: one big round soft blob of soft gray paint with a few small round drops around it, flat soft gray color only, no face, no other colors except the thin outline
words.tip: 看到灰色的石头或小老鼠图说：Gray!

global.sleepy: I'm sleepy. Bye-bye! See you tomorrow!
global.yourTurn: Your turn! Can you say it?
global.goodNight: Good night. Let's say our words.
global.move-hop: Hop like a rabbit! Hop, hop! Your turn!
global.move-flap: Flap your wings like a chicken! Flap, flap! Your turn!
global.move-stretch: Stretch like a cat! Stretch up high! Your turn!
global.move-march: March like a horse! March, march! Your turn!
